title: Presentation Outline
description: Create a logical, audience-ready presentation structure with talking points and suggested visuals.
template:
Create a presentation outline for [TOPIC OR PRESENTATION NAME].

Audience: [E.G. EXECUTIVES / ENGINEERS / STUDENTS / CLIENTS]

Duration: [E.G. 10 MINUTES / 30 MINUTES / 1 HOUR]

Goal: [E.G. PERSUADE / INFORM / TRAIN / PITCH]

Key message: [THE ONE THING YOU WANT THE AUDIENCE TO REMEMBER]

Please provide:
1. **Title and hook** — A strong title and opening line
2. **Slide structure** — Recommended number of slides and flow
3. **Talking points per section** — 2-4 bullets for each major section
4. **Visual recommendations** — Charts, images, or demos that would strengthen each section
5. **Closing** — A summary, Q&A prompt, or call to action
example:
Create a presentation outline for introducing a new internal knowledge base.

Audience: ENGINEERS

Duration: 20 MINUTES

Goal: TRAIN

Key message: The new knowledge base cuts onboarding research time by half.

Please provide:
1. Title and hook
2. Slide structure
3. Talking points per section
4. Visual recommendations
5. Closing
tips: Start with the desired outcome and work backward to the outline
Aim for one main idea per slide to avoid cognitive overload
Add a troubleshooting section for training-style presentations
